title: The Fruit of the Spirit
question: Why is it fruit that is grown, rather than rules that are kept?
blurb: Nine words describing a life. Explore what Scripture says produces them.

nodes.content: Why is it fruit that is grown, rather than rules that are kept?

nodes.verseText: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.
gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
By their fruit you will recognize them. Are grapes gathered from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?
Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
